# DEEPBYTO

> DEEPBYTO is an AI and software company that builds intelligent software, AI-powered solutions, automation systems, digital products, and open-source technologies. Founded to create practical AI solutions for real-world problems, DEEPBYTO serves individuals, startups, SMEs, and enterprises worldwide.

DEEPBYTO focuses on intelligent engineering — combining artificial intelligence, modern software development, and product thinking to deliver systems that solve real problems. The company operates across six service lines: AI Services, Web Services, Software Development, Mobile App Development, Cloud & Deployment, and Maintenance & Support. It also runs a dedicated Business track for long-term enterprise partnerships.

DEEPBYTO provide End-to-End all digital solutions at one place 

## Company

- [About DEEPBYTO](https://deepbyto.github.io/#about): Who DEEPBYTO is, its mission, values, and approach to intelligent engineering.
- [Our Vision](https://deepbyto.github.io/#vision): DEEPBYTO's vision to become a global leader in intelligent software and AI innovation.
- [Our Mission](https://deepbyto.github.io/#mission): DEEPBYTO's mission to engineer intelligent systems that solve real problems with precision and purpose.
- [Business Track](https://deepbyto.github.io/business/index.html): Enterprise and SME solutions — a separate track for companies seeking a long-term technology partner.

## Services

- [AI Services](https://deepbyto.github.io/services/ai-services.html): AI chatbots, AI agents, automation systems, machine learning applications, and custom AI software. Starting at $99.
- [Web Services](https://deepbyto.github.io/services/web-services.html): Modern, responsive, and high-performance websites for individuals, startups, businesses, and organizations. Starting at $5.
- [Software Development](https://deepbyto.github.io/services/software-development-services.html): Custom desktop software, business management systems, enterprise software, automation tools, and professional software solutions. Starting at $99.
- [Mobile App Development](https://deepbyto.github.io/services/mobile-app-development-services.html): Professional Android, iOS, and cross-platform mobile applications built for performance and scalability. Starting at $199.
- [Cloud & Deployment](https://deepbyto.github.io/services/cloud-deployment-services.html): Deployment, cloud configuration, hosting, server setup, infrastructure management, and production deployment services. Starting at $29.
- [Maintenance & Support](https://deepbyto.github.io/services/maintenance-support-services.html): Ongoing maintenance and support for websites, applications, software, and AI solutions. Starting at $19/month.

## Technologies

- [AI Agents](https://deepbyto.github.io/technologies/ai-agents.html): Autonomous systems that reason, plan, and act to complete complex tasks.
- [Automation](https://deepbyto.github.io/technologies/automation.html): Intelligent process orchestration at scale, connecting systems and eliminating manual effort.
